title.zh: 修改用户日志存储时间

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 10 per user. Calls that exceed this limit are rate-limited, which may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw modify-user-sls-log-storage-time --instance-id vipcloudfw-cn-uqm3fz0000 --storage-time 180 --log-version 1 --sls-region-id ap-southeast-1 --region cn-hangzhou
